_readme: Colour code: [[c:...]] CYAN = not confirmed yet (a best guess or a new idea from Claude, for the owner to approve). Plain text = confirmed by the owner.
name: Underpass mural

layers.essential_history: A mural painted by villagers and the school brightens up the underpass. [[c:We're still checking when it was painted and how many people helped.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The mural brightens the underpass beneath the bypass, which the village board says opened in 1996. We'd guess it was painted some years after that, but we still need the date.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:There's no story page here. The mural is just a history stop.]]

puzzle_note: [[c:No puzzle here, just enjoy the artwork.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head north-west for about 60 metres to Warmington Mill. Go through the underpass towards the mill and the water. Keep to the pavements and paths, and look from the road only.]]
